content: In the first task, participants were instructed to read the sentences naturally, without any specific task other than comprehension. Participants were told to read the sentences normally without any special instructions. Figure FIGREF8 (left) shows an example sentence as it was depicted on the screen during recording. As shown in Figure FIGREF8 (middle), the control condition for this task consisted of single-choice questions about the content of the previous sentence. 12% of randomly selected sentences were followed by such a comprehension question with three answer options on a separate screen.
